title: Salah Ben Youssef Assassinated in Frankfurt

title: Bread Riots Erupt After IMF Subsidy Cuts

The core framing that the government 'doubled' bread prices is correct, but the event misattributes the start city as 'Kasserine, Gafsa, and Sidi Bouzid' — the actual start was Nefzaoua. Minor factual inaccuracies in geographic detail elevate to FALSE.
